scenario: [LTIM.2.7.1] makes a positive pattern carrying a `within <dur>` window time-dependent, re-evaluated on every tick, and [LTIM.2.6.2] refuses a time-dependent condition on a rule with more than one positive pattern. Pin: a rule with two positive patterns, the second carrying `within 5_s` and NO clock-reading `where`, rejects with DS_VALIDATE_NOW_MULTIPATTERN_UNSUPPORTED. PATH: dsc.validate's ltim_2_6_2_clock_where, its pattern-`within` arm; a check that looked only at `where` clauses compiles this rule. LTIM.2.6.2_then_within_multipattern_compiles is the twin that keeps the arm from over-reaching.
rules_ds:
schema A scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema B scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule two_pat:
    A
    B within 5_s
->
    log info "both"
